summary:
Comprehensive architectural and security remediation of the SedRazavi WordPress Theme and Universal Elementor Addon Suite (UAS):
1. Excluded child-themes from sedrazavi-theme.zip, reducing package footprint from ~14MB down to ~3MB.
2. Synchronized packaging pipelines between package-theme.js and pack-theme-zips.cjs.
3. Cleaned up non-production staging assets and enforced .gitignore / .distignore exclusions.
4. Hardened AJAX endpoints in class-plugin.php to strictly require manage_options capability.
5. Optimized plugin activation to be instant and timeout-free by decoupling automatic database imports into on-demand user actions.
6. Refactored widget JavaScript (pricing-switcher, fomo-countdown, before-after) into external modular scripts hooked via elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction.
7. Bumped theme version to 6.0.0 with sovereign multi-niche description.
